Hi Samantha —

Thanks for the recap and the attendee list. Congrats on the turnout — nice work. Quick answers up front: we can generate 300 unique voucher codes and we can approve a 90-day trial window for this partner cohort, but we need a couple of clarifications before we push to distribution: 

1) Budget/coverage: our standard sponsorship allowance covers up to 75 free 30-day onramp vouchers per partner webinar. Anything above that typically moves to a paid top-up or a special marketing credit approval. To move faster, would Foundry be able to cover incremental cost for additional codes? If so, please confirm whether the attached PO (DL-2026-0723-PO55421.pdf) will be used to cover the extra 225 codes or if you want Redwood to invoice after distribution.

2) Data/process: please confirm final attendee CSV contains opted-in emails for marketing (we can't send trial assignment to unsubscribed addresses). The attached file looks clean but flagged ~8 duplicates.

3) Distribution email: do you want Redwood to send the code emails directly (we'll use the Redwood templated message with your branding mention) or will Foundry distribute codes on your side? If Redwood sends, we'll need the preferred send date/time and the sender name.

Next steps from our side: Monica (cc'd) will prepare the voucher bundle and a DocuSign addendum to extend the trial window to 90 days for the cohort. Rishi (cc'd) will confirm billing flow (invoice vs PO). If we get the PO confirmation today, we can target code distribution Thu 27 Aug. Otherwise end-of-week is realistic.

If useful, happy to set a 15min call — otherwise confirm in reply and we'll action.

Best,
Laura Bennett
